native.gcan_family: Actual transmitted frame family, unknown. A CAN FD/XL-capable controller may send CC frames, so controller capability does not select this family.
native.gcan_transport_binding: Required actual registered can/can_fd/can_xl link/controller/PHY/bit-timing configuration reference, unknown. Generic wrapper has no independent physical rate.
native.gcan_implementation_source: Required actual encoding/edition/controller/device capability reference, unknown. Generic CAN is an NIS abstraction, not a fourth normative CAN generation.
native.gcan_schedule_source: Required actual identifier ownership/traffic/interference/error/queue schedule reference, unknown. Family shape does not prove arbitration response time.
native.gcan_frame_format: Actual CC/FD11-bit or29-bit frame format, or XL separated priority/acceptance format. No inferred standard format.
native.gcan_frame_kind: Actual DATA/REMOTE frame. Only CC supports remote requests; remote wire data is empty even when requested data length is nonzero.
native.gcan_identifier: Actual CC/FD arbitration identifier, unknown. Standard11-bit ceiling2047, extended29-bit ceiling536870911. Not XL acceptance or priority field.
native.gcan_priority_id: Actual XL11-bit priority ID, unknown. Not a CAN CC/FD application identifier or generic QoS priority3.
native.gcan_acceptance_field: Actual XL32-bit acceptance field, unknown, separate from arbitration priority.
native.gcan_requested_bytes: Actual CC remote requested length0..8, unknown; not transmitted remote payload or FD/XL data length.
native.payload_bytes: Actual on-wire data-field octets. CC0..8, FD discrete0..8/12/16/20/24/32/48/64, XL1..2048. CC REMOTE has0 wire data. Application encoding/padding and selected lower link remain actual configuration, no8 proposal.

removed.bitrate: Remove unsourced500k proposal; wrapper requires actual explicit registered CAN family transport/PHY/bit timing, no separate fixed generic rate.
removed.qos_priority: Identifier arbitration/XL priority differs from generic priority3.
removed.reserved_bandwidth_percent: Actual interference/traffic/arbitration instead of universal reservation0.
removed.sync_method: Actual upper-layer/device synchronization differs from universal NONE/PTP/NTP.
removed.retransmission_enabled: Actual CAN controller retry/error behavior is not a generic switchfalse.
removed.gateway_maximum_throughput: No universal100M generic CAN gateway throughput.
removed.queue_policy: Actual controller queues/identifier arbitration require matched transport, not generic FIFO certification.

revisions: CiA primary CAN generation, CAN FD and CAN XL descriptions read2026-10-01; ISO11898-1:2024 referenced, full licensed text not read
NIS abstraction/policy: transport family reference, not independent generic CAN normative standard
scope: Every original generic CAN parameter reviewed individually. Unsourced500k/8-byte defaults removed; explicit family/link/implementation/schedule required, CC/FD/XL actual wire payload and address format scoped independently.

validation.suite: full_parameter_audit + standard_defaults + profile_semantics + capacity_can_schedule + parameter_review + required_parameters + physical_profiles

not_certified: Actual binding lookup/execution against registered can/can_fd/can_xl port/PHY/rates/clock/error/PMA/encoding/device profile; references alone do not resolve hardware
Complete encoded DLC/CRC/stuffing/padding/error/interference/queue/arbitration response and application acceptance; generic wrapper has no own executable capacity model, MODEL_MISSING remains
Full ISO11898 and controller conformance; CC/FD/XL registered profiles remain separately reviewed, no transport default is invented for the generic wrapper
